Important notes & pricing scope
  • Pricing scope: All prices include the $15 wrapper fee on Current Owner, 24-Month Current Owner, and Two Owner reports. Pricing assumes a single residential parcel with standard DataTrace deliverables.
  • Multi-parcel / extra chain / unusual searches: Not covered by these prices — quoted separately with prior customer authorization.
  • Commercial properties: Not covered. All commercial requests are vetted and quoted on a case-by-case basis.
  • Texas: These products are not intended for issuance of title insurance. A separate rate card and agreement with TitleVision Texas, LLC is required for insured products in their 30 licensed counties.
  • Washington restricted plant counties: For King, Pierce, and Snohomish counties, online pricing on Full Title, Preliminary Refi Long, and Preliminary Resale products requires an executed DataTrace plant agreement. Without one, those orders default to Ground pricing (not shown here).
  • Online vs Ground: This tool reflects Online pricing only (counties servable via title plants, county websites, or other online services). Ground pricing applies to counties requiring local vendor servicing.
  • Pass-through copy costs: Where shown as "Pass through," document copy fees from the county are billed in addition to the listed price.
  • SLA: Estimated turn-time in business hours, assuming standard deliverables.
